description: Enumerate the tickers an Event Card basket leg resolves for, so an agent can pick symbols that will price instead of guessing. kind='etf' lists every exchange-listed fund (SPY, QQQ, IWM, TLT, GLD, ...); kind='crypto' lists coins on the live websocket feed. Plain stocks are not listed: any exchange-listed stock with a live quote resolves, so check one with preview_card_basket. Read-only.
name: list_priceable_basket_symbols
title: List Priceable Basket Symbols
